content.who_must_report: Public companies with complex capital structures (common stock plus potentially dilutive securities) must report BOTH basic and diluted EPS
content.basic_eps_formula: Basic EPS = (Net Income - Preferred Dividends) / Weighted Average Common Shares Outstanding

numerator_calculation.start_with_net_income: Net income (bottom line from income statement)

subtract_preferred_dividends.cumulative_preferred: Deduct dividends for current year (whether declared or not)
subtract_preferred_dividends.note: Preferred dividends reduce income available to common shareholders

numerator_calculation.example: Net income $500K. Cumulative preferred stock: 10,000 shares, $100 par, 6% dividend rate. Preferred dividend = 10,000 × $100 × 6% = $60K. Income available to common = $500K - $60K = $440K.

denominator_calculation.weighted_average_shares: Shares outstanding weighted by portion of year outstanding
denominator_calculation.formula: Weighted Average = Σ (Shares × Fraction of year outstanding)
denominator_calculation.exclude_treasury_shares: Outstanding shares = Issued shares - Treasury shares
denominator_calculation.time_weighting: Weight by days or months outstanding during the year

stock_dividends_and_splits.retroactive_adjustment: Stock dividends and splits treated as if occurred at BEGINNING of year (or beginning of earliest period presented)
stock_dividends_and_splits.apply_to_all_periods: Adjust weighted average shares for all periods presented retroactively
stock_dividends_and_splits.example: 10% stock dividend on Dec 31. Adjust all shares outstanding during year by 1.10 factor, as if dividend occurred Jan 1.

calculation_example_1_basic.facts: Net income $600K. Preferred dividends $50K (cumulative, all paid). Shares outstanding: Jan 1: 100,000. April 1: Issued 20,000. July 1: Reacquired 10,000 treasury. October 1: Reissued 5,000 treasury.

calculation_example_2_stock_dividend.facts: Net income $400K. No preferred stock. Shares outstanding Jan 1: 100,000. June 30: Issued 20,000 shares for cash. Nov 30: 10% stock dividend.
calculation_example_2_stock_dividend.adjustment_for_stock_dividend: Retroactively adjust all shares by 1.10 factor (as if stock dividend occurred Jan 1)

calculation_example_3_stock_split.facts: Net income $300K. No preferred. Jan 1: 50,000 shares outstanding. March 31: 2-for-1 stock split. June 30: Issued 10,000 shares for cash.
calculation_example_3_stock_split.adjustment_for_split: Retroactively adjust all shares before split by factor of 2

discontinued_operations_eps.separate_presentation: Report EPS separately for: (1) Income from continuing operations, (2) Discontinued operations, (3) Net income
discontinued_operations_eps.example:
Basic EPS:
  Continuing operations $3.50
  Discontinued operations (0.50)
  Net income $3.00

comparative_statements.restatement_required: If stock dividend or split occurs, restate EPS for all prior periods presented

preferred_stock_considerations.cumulative_preferred: Deduct current year dividends even if not declared (in arrears)
preferred_stock_considerations.participating_preferred: Deduct contractual dividends and any participating dividends
preferred_stock_considerations.convertible_preferred: For basic EPS, treat as preferred (deduct dividends). For diluted EPS, may be antidilutive.

antidilution.basic_eps_no_antidilution: Basic EPS does not consider potential dilution (use only actual shares outstanding)
antidilution.simple_capital_structure: If only common stock (no potentially dilutive securities), report only basic EPS (no diluted EPS required)

cpa_exam_tips: Basic EPS = (NI - Preferred Dividends) / Weighted Avg Shares
Cumulative preferred: Deduct dividends whether declared or not. Noncumulative: Only if declared.
Weighted average: Weight shares by time outstanding (months/days)
Stock dividends and splits: Retroactive adjustment as if occurred at beginning of year
Treasury shares: Exclude from outstanding shares (Outstanding = Issued - Treasury)
Report separate EPS for continuing ops, discontinued ops, and net income if discontinued ops present

numerator_steps: 2. Subtract preferred dividends (cumulative: full amount; noncumulative: only if declared)
3. Result = Income available to common shareholders
denominator_steps: 1. List all share transactions during year (issuances, treasury purchases, treasury reissuances)
2. Calculate shares outstanding for each period between transactions
3. If stock dividend/split occurred: Retroactively adjust all shares before the event
4. Weight each period's shares by time outstanding (months/12 or days/365)
cpa_exam_strategies.stock_dividend_split_approach: Apply adjustment factor to ALL shares outstanding before the stock dividend/split date (as if event occurred at beginning of year)
common_mistakes: Forgetting to deduct cumulative preferred dividends (even if not declared)
Including treasury shares in outstanding shares (should exclude)
Not retroactively adjusting for stock dividends/splits
Applying stock dividend adjustment only to shares before the event (must apply to all prior months)

key_points: Basic EPS = (Net Income - Preferred Dividends) / Weighted Average Common Shares Outstanding
Cumulative preferred: Always deduct dividends. Noncumulative: Only if declared.
Weighted average shares: Weight by time outstanding
Stock dividends and splits: Retroactive adjustment to all shares before event
Outstanding shares = Issued shares - Treasury shares
Report separate EPS for continuing operations, discontinued operations, and net income
